svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: Technologies orbiting a glowing core: LangGraph, LangChain, ChromaDB, BM25 and RAG closest in; PyTorch, Hugging Face, TinyBERT, Scikit-learn, Pandas and NumPy in the middle; Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Java, SQL, PostgreSQL, React and Docker on the outside.
svg.text: agent frameworks inside, models in the middle, engineering on the outside
